note: DRY component families this concept exercises (names are candidate design roles, not final component IDs). Each entry states the role, which C3/core surfaces use it, and a reuse note flagging how Stack adapts the shared grammar. No new component is minted where a shared family already covers the role.

components.role: Expandable destination row that opens a place (not a filter); carries icon, title, purpose, status, and an expand/collapse affordance.
used_by: every C3 destination (File Manager, Terminal, LSP, Formatters, Commands & Shortcuts, MCP, Skills/Plugins/Tools, Testing)
components.reuse_note: Shared family reused unchanged in intent; Stack renders destinations as expandable rows instead of navigating to a separate page. Open affordance = expand-in-place, superseding bloom.

components.role: Status-critical notice at the head of the stack with one clear action (attention / continue / recommended).
components.reuse_note: Shared grammar reused; Stack pins notices to the stack head so they remain visible above expanded destinations.

components.role: Surrounding workspace: loads one major surface at a time, sticky subnav, deep-link, manager-load-does-not-block.
components.reuse_note: Shell contract reused unchanged; Stack renders the body as a single expandable stack rather than a split rail. active_destination_id + active_subcategory are the portable semantic state.

components.role: Omni-search across settings/categories/managers/destinations; selecting a result deep-links.
used_by: stack head (search is the HEAD of the single stack)
components.reuse_note: Reused unchanged; in Stack the result deep-link expands the target destination in place and focus-flashes the row (no bloom modal).

components.role: Top-level category index.
components.reuse_note: Reused; categories collapse to expandable destination rows. Selecting a category expands it rather than swapping the whole pane.

components.role: Active-subcategory tracking with controlled jump + focus-flash.
used_by: expanded destination body (sticky in-row subnav pills)
components.reuse_note: Role reused; the mechanism is portable: active pill is model state (PM.state.active_subcategory). Web demo uses scrollspy; Slint maps to a visibility/offset hook, not DOM measurement.

components.role: Ordinary setting row: nine-state chip, value source, exposure filter, scope (Global/Project).
components.reuse_note: Shared grammar reused unchanged across all families; this is the universal atom. Blank is never a state.

components.role: Inline manager surface (resource list + detail) hosted inside an expanded destination.
components.reuse_note: Shared shell reused; Stack embeds it in the expanded destination body (not a separate page). Manager loads async and does not block the workspace.

components.role: Typed resource listing for managers; card + detail variants per kind.
components.reuse_note: Shared list/card/detail reused with a kind discriminator; the four C3 kinds (skill/plugin/tool/command-as-kind) render through the same family with distinct lifecycle fields.

components.role: Aggregated health (detected/not-found/disabled/healthy/failed) for a resource family.
components.reuse_note: Reused unchanged; rolls up per-resource health into a family summary line.

components.role: Typed resource card for a language server: provenance, startup mode, requested/effective attachment, formatting-ownership flag, restart/logs.
components.reuse_note: Specialization of ResourceCard; carries the LSP-specific conflict badge that feeds cmd.lsp.formatting_ownership.resolve.

components.role: Typed resource card for a formatter: per-language owner, command/env/ext, scope, health, test-result.
components.reuse_note: Specialization of ResourceCard; carries the single-ownership-per-language resolve affordance.

components.role: Typed resource card for a tool rendering the 5-state lifecycle ladder (installed / project-enabled / currently-available / selected-for-turn / actually-invoked).
used_by: Tools kind axis inside the Skills manager
components.reuse_note: Specialization of ResourceCard; pairs with RequestedEffectiveInspector to expose effective-availability vs requested state.

components.role: Editor for custom commands: body, parameters, includes, shell-safety scan, mode (safe/normal/unrestricted), dry-run gate.
components.reuse_note: Concept-specific role; the dry-run button is hard-wired to dispatch_target=preview_only and never offers 'send to agent'.

components.role: Captures a key combo for a binding with inline conflict detection against existing bindings + when-clauses.
components.reuse_note: Concept-specific role; conflict detection runs at capture time and routes to cmd.shortcuts.conflict.resolve on clash.

components.role: Launches an install/setup flow when a resource is not-found/unavailable (e.g. shfmt missing, simulator absent, provider not signed in).
components.reuse_note: Shared family reused; routes to the correct owner (BinaryLocator for binaries, PM-direct/CLI OAuth for providers).

components.role: Wraps a user action as an observable work item with progress/result/failure.
components.reuse_note: Shared family reused; every C3 action surfaces as an ObservableOperation.

components.role: Deep-linkable receipt attached to an operation outcome.
components.reuse_note: Shared family reused; receipts carry owner-tagged ids so the audit trail can attribute usage/diagnostics.

components.role: Shows requested vs effective state diff (LSP attachment, tool 5-state availability, provider requested/effective, MCP transport).
components.reuse_note: Shared family reused; the requested/effective distinction is the portable part. Drives AvailabilityReason when effective degrades.

components.role: Explains why a resource/capability is unavailable (simulator not installed, remote-LSP degraded, MCP unreachable, tool not currently-available) without a hard error.
components.reuse_note: Shared family reused; never blocks the workspace; always offers a recovery deep-link.

components.role: Indicates where a setting value comes from (Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Custom/Managed).
used_by: all SettingRow instances across C3 + core
components.reuse_note: Shared atom reused; pairs with the nine-state chip so blank is never a state.

components.role: Typed card for a provider/model installation fixture with verify/rollback status and OAuth-boundary label.
components.reuse_note: Shared family reused; CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary is shown as a distinct label per card. Verify-failed-then-rollback is fixture #8.

summary.note: No component is minted where a shared family covers the role; the C3-specific work is in typed resource cards (Lsp/Formatter/Tool) and the command/shortcut editors, all of which compose over shared ManagerShell + ResourceList/Card/Detail.
